name: trust-no-agent
description: Trust over speed for coding agents — the router (AGENTS.md + WORKFLOW.md), 11 discipline skills, and the mechanical enforcement layer: floor re-injection and per-prompt MANDATORY classification.

interface.shortDescription: Discipline the agent will not skip
interface.longDescription: Four Iron Laws, eleven discipline skills, and a mechanical boundary the model does not have to remember: the session-start floor is re-injected from the router, and every prompt is classified against the MANDATORY domains (expect-fail, root-cause, receipts) with a LOAD directive injected when one is touched. Self-trigger measured 0/3 — the hooks exist because relying on the model to remember fails silently.
